# GHL India Ventures

> SEBI-registered Category II Alternative Investment Fund (Registration No.
> IN/AIF2/24-25/1517), headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. The fund
> invests in stressed real estate recovered through NCLT / IBC resolution
> processes, and in early-stage ventures.

This content is published for educational and informational purposes only. It
is not an offer, invitation or solicitation to invest. Units of an Alternative
Investment Fund are offered exclusively by private placement to eligible
investors, under a Private Placement Memorandum filed with SEBI. Past
performance is not indicative of future results.

## Entity facts

- Legal name: GHL India Ventures
- Regulator: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
- Registration: Category II AIF, No. IN/AIF2/24-25/1517
- Registered office: 2D, Queens Court, No. 6, Montieth Road, Egmore, Chennai 600008, Tamil Nadu, India
- Telephone: +91 44 2843 1043
- Email: info@ghlindiaventures.com
- Strategy: stressed / distressed real estate acquired through IBC and NCLT resolution; early-stage venture investments

## Core explainers

- [Why AIFs](https://ghlindiaventures.com/why-aifs/): What an Alternative Investment Fund is, how Categories I, II and III differ, and who is eligible to invest under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, 2012.
- [Category II AIF in India — complete guide](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/category-ii-aif-india-complete-guide/): Structure, regulatory obligations, custodial safeguards and risk profile.
- [Stressed real estate and NCLT resolution](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/stressed-real-estate-nclt-hidden-value/): How distressed property is acquired through the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, and where the recoverable value actually sits.
- [How stressed real estate investing works in a Category II AIF](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/how-stressed-real-estate-investing-works-category-ii-aif/): The acquisition-to-exit sequence, step by step.
- [AIF vs PMS](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/aif-vs-pms-which-is-right-for-hnis/): Structure, taxation and suitability compared.
- [AIF vs mutual funds](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/aif-vs-mutual-funds-which-is-better-for-hnis/): Liquidity, regulation and investor eligibility compared.
- [AIF taxation in India](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/aif-taxation-in-india-explained-tax-rules-hnis-should-know/): Pass-through status, TDS and the rules that apply to Category II funds.
- [SEBI Co-Invest Framework explained](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/sebi-co-invest-framework-explained-a-simple-walkthrough-for-first-time-alternative-investors/): What co-investment is and how SEBI regulates it.
- [NRI investment into Indian AIFs](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/nris-guide-to-investing-in-indian-aifs-process-repatriation-tax-rules/): FEMA and RBI requirements, repatriation and tax treatment.
- [SEBI AIF regulations — what changed](https://ghlindiaventures.com/blog/sebi-aif-regulations-2026-what-changed/): Recent amendments and their practical effect on investors.
